time_model: serial per step: GPU (dense + routed expert bytes) / 426.6 GB/s (a batch-1 token = the RTX 5080's 4.5 ms all-resident estimate) + H2D of RAM and SSD misses at 47.5 GB/s + D2H demotions at 47.5 GB/s + demand SSD bytes at 2.6 GB/s (M7, 2 workers; ms_per_token_ssd_floor adds a per-layer depth-1 floor of 1.24 / 1.40 ms) + (a)'s promotion stalls and reader waits; promotion reads are background on the same reader

decision.ram_short_default: F11 with deferred admission (b), the map flipped at the first stream-ordered step (c+1 when the D2H demotion and the D2D copy are ordered before launch c+1; else c+2); keep demand SSD reads in RAM
decision.where_each_wins_at_flip_c2: (b) least mean time in 5 of 9 cells (24 of 45 pair-cells): 10% VRAM at every RAM fraction by 7-21%, 25% VRAM with RAM >= 50% of the rest by 3-6%; (c) the other 4 (25%/25% and 47% VRAM) by 0.9-2.7% (15 of their 20 pair-cells); (a) none, 1.2-3.7x the best on the mean
decision.at_flip_c1: (b) wins all 45 pair-cells, (c) 3-36% slower; the least mean in every cell with D2H overlapped, the depth-1 floor, demotions landing at c+2, F10 refilled at c+2 (D4), RAM heat decay 0.99 or 1.0; with keep on both, all 45 pair-cells
decision.keep: keeping demand SSD reads in RAM (no I/O) cuts (b) by 3-28% (c+2) and 2-27% (c+1)
decision.cost_vs_ram_holding_all: 1.9-7.9x (b at c+1), 2.2-8.3x (b at c+2) the time of lfu with RAM holding every expert

contradictions: D10's churn estimate (157 MB/token of SSD re-reads for (a) at 25%) is low: 235 MB/token on agent with background promotion at every RAM fraction (RAM drains: ~55 admissions/token free slots the 2.6 GB/s reader refills ~40 MB/token), 310 without promotion, 120 with free promotion; (a) is 2.1-3.7x (b) at 25% VRAM with RAM >= 50% of the rest

D10's (b) 'victim demoted D2H into the freed RAM slot': the admitted expert's RAM slot frees only after its map flips plus the delta-log lag, so the victim needs a free-slot pool (fed by flips and releases) or must displace RAM's coldest

the fixed flip at +2 costs 5-14% against +1; the admission is in-graph (no host in the loop), so D4's c+2 for host edits need not apply when the demotion and the staged copy are stream-ordered before the next launch
Maya's 'else disk-only' wastes a demand SSD read already in host memory; keeping it is a free 3-28% for (b)
D4's F10 (spare refill as a host edit at c+2) is not the F10 M6 and (c) replayed (refill every boundary); the D4 form is -8% to +2% of (c) and changes no conclusion
